extracted.course_title: Ethics, Communication, and Tools for Software Development

prerequisites.evidence: Prerequisite: grade C or better in CSC 210 or equivalent
Prerequisite: grade C or better in English 214 or equivalent

other_requirements.evidence: Prerequisite: grade C or better in CSC 210 or equivalent; grade C or better in English 214 or equivalent.

learning_outcomes: Evaluate social and ethical issues that are associated with the access, control and distribution of online information or developing software.
Understand the department's ethics and plagiarism policy.
Understand, evaluate and apply various legal, privacy and intellectual property concerns related to online information and software.
Understand professional responsibility, accountability when writing software.
Use written and oral communication effectively in the context of computer science ethics and collaborative software development.
topics: Freedom of speech and content moderation
Ethics of computing research and presentations

skills.evidence: One of the main goals for this course is to develop critical thinking regarding the technologies we use and develop. In doing so, we will focus on ethical reasoning
You will develop practical skills in reading, writing, and discussing.
